torch_allocator_statistics_note: Caching is disabled; unavailable PyTorch allocated/reserved statistics are not zero total process memory. NVML samples include identified concurrent parent and descendants on explicit target GPU.
cautions: Single observations on shared hardware; other GPU processes were present. This is measured whole-run improvement, not established stable throughput.
No official reference speed ratio inferred from this matched FNIT before/after pair.
Nested surface timings are already included in parent top-level stages and must not be summed into whole time.
topology_python_seconds additionally includes remesh and intersection; it is intentionally not listed as an independent nested duration.
Native white/pial timings improved without corresponding native algorithm changes; variation cannot be credited to a GPU replacement.
Normalisation is slower in this whole GPU run despite exact same-input CPU stage regressions; cause requires targeted profiling, not assumed randomness.
Memory monitor sampling differs (2 seconds baseline vs 1 second candidate); both sampled peaks below 20,000,000,000 bytes, neither certifies the continuous peak.
Strict reproduction and whole metric equivalence are evaluated separately by comparison reports; this timing report makes no equivalence claim.
